sectionSubtitle: Engineering with Taste. Built to Convert.
sectionDescription: Bridging the gap between high-end visual design and rigorous frontend engineering. No cookie-cutter templates, no bloated page builders — just bespoke, lightning-fast digital experiences.

faqs.question: What is your typical project timeline and turnaround?
faqs.answer: Most bespoke websites and redesigns are completed within 2 to 4 weeks from kickoff to production launch. Because you work directly with me without agency account layers, decisions and iterations happen in hours rather than weeks.

faqs.question: How does your design-to-code process operate?
faqs.answer: We begin with collaborative Figma prototypes to calibrate typography, spatial rhythm, and motion direction. Once approved, I translate every frame into clean React 19, TypeScript, and modern CSS with 60fps micro-animations and zero layout shift.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee 100/100 Lighthouse performance & SEO?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every site is engineered around strict Core Web Vitals standards — zero bloated scripts, hardware-accelerated transforms, optimized next-gen WebP assets, and semantic JSON-LD structured data for maximal search visibility.

faqs.question: What pricing structures and engagement models do you offer?
faqs.answer: I offer transparent, fixed-scope project pricing with clear milestone deliverables, as well as dedicated monthly retainers for fast-moving businesses requiring continuous design engineering and feature development.

faqs.question: What support is included after the project is launched?
faqs.answer: Every launch comes with 30 days of complimentary post-launch warranty covering any adjustments, domain configuration, analytics tracking verification, and detailed documentation so you have complete ownership.
